try a different weighting scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if a less aggressive weight improves robustness in this trend‑dominated, unstable‑ranking series.

The series has unstable rankings (tau=0.283) and is trend-dominated; a robust non‑linear combination like a median over the full pool may outperform the trimmed mean.
Try a per‑horizon weighted combination to capture changing best models across the 13‑step horizon, since ranking is unstable and the trend dominates.

The series has unstable rankings and a strong trend; a per‑pool softmax weighting may better adapt to the pool4 subset while keeping robustness.
Try a simple robust mean over the stable pool (trend-dominated, unstable ranking) to see if a plain average beats weighted combos.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 0.5971. Series context: trend strength 0.9943 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.283); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 19.218.
